problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{7}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{7}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=3{x}^{2}-1$ for $x\in [-7,7).$ The Fourier series of the $14$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{0}.$

${a}_{0}=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the constant term is given by

$$
{a}_{0}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=7$ and $f(x)=3{x}^{2}-1$ for $x\in [-7,7).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =\frac{1}{7}{\int }_{-7}^{7}(3{x}^{2}-1)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{7}{[{x}^{3}-x]}_{-7}^{7} \\  & =\frac{1}{7}(({7}^{3}-7)-((-7)^{3}-(-7))) \\  & =\frac{1}{7}(336-(-336)) \\  & =96.\end{aligned}
$$
